title: RESEARCH-01 Locaily Decision Track Bakeoff & External Benchmark Harness
purpose: Establish a first-class DecisionCapability track contract compatible with the SystemOne / Jev / Clef API, and conduct a reproducible bakeoff across deterministic rules, small generative LLMs, and local decision models over 10 Locaily routing scenarios.
problem: Locaily routing, task intake, and fallback evaluation currently rely on either rigid exact-match conditions or slow, token-heavy generative LLMs that require markdown/JSON parsing. The ecosystem now provides open, sub-40ms decision models (Clef-Flash 9B, Clef 27B) and standardized benchmarks (Decision Index 0.2.1), but Locaily lacks a typed decision contract, adapter, and qualification bakeoff.

included: Evaluation metrics: accuracy, expected calibration error (ECE), latency (p50/p99), VRAM/RAM footprint, abstention/error rate
Decision Index 0.2.1 test runner adapter and reproduction guide
excluded: Monolithic rewrite of Locaily coordinator around Clef
Replacing or deprecating existing generative tracks (core.classify, core.summarize, core.extract)
Mandatory cloud-hosted endpoints or non-local dependencies
Automatic live model enforcement promotion without operator review

acceptanceCriteria.description: Typed JSON schema defining DecisionCapabilityContract (state context + typed questions array -> discrete answers, bounded probabilities, confidence, abstain flag).
SystemOne-compatible adapter in Benchmark Lab supporting mock fixtures, local /v1/systemone endpoints, and configurable question limits.
Canonical benchmark fixture suite with 10 representative Locaily routing scenarios across intake, modality, model tier, relay placement, risk gate, and fallback ladder.
Reproducible comparison run measuring accuracy, expected calibration error (ECE), latency, VRAM, and failure rate across Rules Baseline, small LLM, and Clef/Clef-Flash.
External benchmark harness runner integrating Decision Index 0.2.1 into Benchmark Lab evidence format.
